description: U.S. Synthetic Residential Building Telemetry Dataset Generated with EnergyPlus is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors You-Jeong Kim, Yun Kyu Yi. This dataset provides national-scale synthetic residential building telemetry generated using EnergyPlus. It includes detached and attached residential models developed from probability distributions derived from actual ecobee DYD homes and the U.S. residential building stock. The dataset covers 48 contiguous U.S. states and 13 ASHRAE climate zones. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
